resources.string: Tracks the foreground app and automates the system Force stop screen when you trigger ApKilla.
Force-stop the app you were just using from Quick Settings, a home-screen shortcut, or the ApKilla icon menu. No root, ADB, Shizuku or Tasker.

Android may briefly show the App info screen while ApKilla presses Force stop and confirms it automatically. The tile is now kept as an action button instead of being visually disabled during temporary service state changes.
